newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse rebounds after weak start.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse rebounds after weak start.

text.p: The Madrid bourse slipped lower at the open on Thursday, consolidating recent strong gains, but quickly resumed its upward trend, dealers said.
* General index rises 2.72 points, 0.44 pct, to 621.08.
* Ibex-35 index rises 26.31 points, 0.37 pct, to 7,121.26.
* Electricity stocks flat to lower after reports that government foresees 4.5 percent fall in electricity tariffs in 1998.
"There is strong interest in the market from domestic investors and due to a lack of paper any buying interest is pushing the market higher," said one dealer.
